case.summary: Alert HHG-013 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.76 on transaction 3526826 ($35.66, online) on card C07671-K2. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored this transaction at 0.006, reflecting a 0.6% historical fraud rate. Device D008387 exhibits a generic browser profile with no proxy, no ring association, and zero fraud across 63 cards in the preceding 30 days. No testing sequences, velocity spikes, or disputes were observed, and the current holder identity has no confirmed fraud history. The transaction is ruled legitimate cardholder activity and closed as a false alarm.
